description: Press every key and watch it light up: find dead keys, stuck keys and ghosting in a minute. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

layout.description: Keyboard layout, which decides the printed labels and whether the board is ANSI or ISO: us (ANSI), uk, de (QWERTZ), fr (AZERTY), es, it, pt-br (ABNT2), da, no, sv (Swedish and Finnish share one).

pressed.description: The KeyboardEvent.code of every key that was pressed, in any order, duplicates allowed. Use code (the physical position), not key (the character typed). Empty returns the whole keyboard as untested.

items.description: A KeyboardEvent.code value, e.g. KeyA, Digit1, ShiftLeft, Space, Numpad5.

size.description: full (with numpad), tkl (no numpad) or laptop (no numpad and no Insert/Home/Page cluster, arrows kept). Keys the keyboard does not have are not counted as untested.

system.description: windows labels Ctrl/Win/Alt; mac labels control/option/command, drops the Menu key and uses Apple's numpad.

name: keyboard_tester
title: Keyboard Tester
